basic_info_description:
Furnished, Modern Executive Flat with Best Views and Location 

Rare find! Enjoy the good life at 426 Vallejo St, a fully furnished, modern, turnkey-ready flat perched on the famous Vallejo Street Steps of Telegraph Hill. Enjoy $5M views of San Francisco's Bay Bridge and the Bay from your living room. 
+ Quiet, sunny flat set amidst lush gardens yet a 5-minute walk to downtown San Francisco and lively North Beach and Chinatown with renowned restaurants and cafes
+ Bright, open concept floor plan connects beautiful living room to spacious eat-in kitchen and home office
+ $500 Refund with move-in by January 16
+ 9-foot ceilings and gleaming hardwood floors throughout
+ Comfortable, modern furniture and original art make this a special home
+ Home is completely outfitted and turnkey ready with all furniture, appliances, housewares, bedding and linens
+ Living room features a wall of windows, Norwegian natural gas fireplace, Austin leather chair with ottoman, 55-inch LG Smart TV, nice stereo, DVD/Blue ray player with 150+ movies
+ Fully wired with Bluetooth speakers, Netflix, all network channels and dozens of specialty and foreign channels
+ Kitchen includes marble counters, new stainless Samsung gas stove, dishwasher and Keurig & Nespresso coffee makers with dozens of flavors
+ Enjoy outdoor meals or a book on your front doorstep with sweeping Bay Bridge views, surrounded by the gardens of the Vallejo Street steps 
+ Large bedroom has luxurious Queen 14-inch memory foam mattress, down comforter, hotel-quality gel pillows and large walk-in closet
+ Newly renovated bathroom includes European-style towel warmer, 100% cotton towels and new spa-style bath robes
+ Bright home office has AirPrint to print from your computer or Smartphone 
+ Private outdoor patio for intimate meals, reading and relaxation
+ Laundry in building
+ Water and trash included in rent
+ Cleaning service available upon request
+ Private parking possible on same block for $350/month
+ Seeking 12-month or 6-month lease with shorter term available

Text or email Ethan for a safe, private viewing.

Trash, Water and Netflix paid by Owner; Tenant pays for other utilities
Rent is $3650 for 12 month lease with $750 refund for move-in by January 16;
$3,850 for 6 months; 
$3,950 for 2-5 months
